correctness.rationale: The 8-vertex cube has 12 edges and 24 oriented primitive matchings. Exhaustive face vector (24,240,1296,4080,7488,7424,3072) was derived independently of the matching. The staged matching gives 11,700 ordinary pairs and critical cells 1 in dimension0, 44 in dimension5, 179 in dimension6; a topological sort checks 124,200 augmented Hasse incidences. The 44-by-179 signed integer gradient-path degree matrix has 195 nonzero entries; forty unimodular unit pivots leave zero residual. An independent Smith normal form on the same generated matrix confirms 40 unit factors. Because the 5-skeleton is a wedge of 5-spheres, Hurewicz converts degrees into complete 6-cell attaching-map data and degree-one cells can be cancelled, leaving 4 S5 and 139 S6. Direct mod-two boundary ranks check every homological dimension; finite exhaustive proof does not imply other cubes.

value.rationale: Q3 is the smallest genuinely non-cycle hypercube and has a previously published, explicitly mod-two-only Morse-complex calculation. Determining its integral homotopy type eliminates torsion/attaching ambiguities and shows a natural mixed-dimensional wedge of spheres, giving a precise canonical topological invariant rather than an arbitrary slice or known-table recomputation. The statement is finite and complete; no broader theorem is required for its mathematical value.
